title: POÄNG rocking chair
description: POÄNG rocking chair, birch veneer/Knisa black Simple, timeless design that’s still going strong after 40 years in our stores. It’s loved by all ages so we made a grown-up size and a children’s size. There's lots of cushions to choose from. The high back provides good support for your neck.
features: Possible to separate for recycling or energy recovery if available in your community.
